topics.label: Introduction to the complement lecture
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the complement system and frames the scope of the lecture.

topics.label: Fundamentals and core principles of the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational principles, naming conventions, and central role of C3 that govern the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three upstream pathways that converge to trigger complement activation on target surfaces.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream processes through which activated complement destroys pathogens and drives inflammation.

topics.label: Host cell regulation of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory mechanisms that prevent complement from damaging host cells.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct disease presentations resulting from deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how pathogens, specifically Staphylococcus aureus, counteract and evade complement-mediated killing.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of next session
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the discussion on complement and previews the upcoming lecture on the adaptive immune system.
